vis.scope: Existing MeasurementSet path. The literal SPECTRAL_WINDOW and WEATHER tables supply the frequency and station samples. The earliest main TIME supplies the season when WEATHER cannot be used.

seasonal_weight.scope: Linear seasonal weighting, including extrapolation. Unavailable station data use the seasonal model alone. Nonfinite weights return nonfinite opacity when plotting is off.

doPlot.scope: Prepare the five-panel weather summary when station data are available. False returns just the spectral-window opacity.

plotName.scope: Optional Matplotlib output name. The default appends .plotweather.png to the MeasurementSet name.

behaviors.title: VLA zenith opacity
behaviors.scope: Apply the station temperature and dew point and the seasonal EVLA Memo 143 model to the installed CASA VLA reference fit. This yields one NumPy float64 in a list for each spectral window in table order.

behaviors.title: Weather summary figure
behaviors.scope: Plot solar elevation at the VLA, wind, temperature and dew point, precipitable water and opacity. The Python host renders and saves the 150 dpi figure through the shared plot document.

paired.kind: Same-input CASA Python results and Matplotlib artists
paired.scope: Zenith opacity per spectral window and the five-panel weather figure. Includes weather and seasonal weighting, fallback for absent, empty or unreadable WEATHER tables, fractional UTC times, named and default PNGs, and typed validation.
paired.result: 10 paired opacity cases, 15 panels, 13 exact errors and five numerical laws passed.
